# disperseR

`disperseR` segments animal movement trajectories into **movement
phases**, with a focus on long-range movements. It separates
area-restricted phases (ARP), where the animal stays in a limited area,
from the movements between them, and classifies each movement according
to the network of areas the individual has already visited:

| Phase | Meaning |
|----|----|
| **ARP** | Area-restricted phase: the animal remains in a limited area (home range, settlement area, long stop). |
| **Type 0** | Unanchored movement: before the first ARP (e.g. after release or leaving the natal area). |
| **Type 1** | Loop: the animal leaves an ARP and returns to the same one. |
| **Type 2** | Expansion: the animal reaches a new ARP, not visited before. |
| **Type 3** | Internal transit: the animal moves to a different ARP that it had already visited. |
| **Type 2 or Type 1** | The track ends while the animal is moving, so the movement cannot be classified. |

At fine temporal resolution, hidden Markov models (HMM) mostly describe
*activity modes* (resting, moving), and a dispersing or migrating animal
also rests every day. `disperseR` uses the HMM states only as a first
step and identifies phases from space use over several days, with
density-based clustering (DBSCAN).

## Installation

Once on CRAN:

``` r

install.packages("disperseR")
```

Development version from GitHub:

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("cherraiz/disperseR")
```

From a local copy of the source:

``` r

install.packages("path/to/disperseR", repos = NULL, type = "source")
```

## Workflow

| Step | Function |
|----|----|
| Split tracks at long monitoring gaps | [`divide.track.by.gap()`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/divide.track.by.gap.md) |
| Regularise locations with continuous-time movement models (`ctmm`) | [`resample.ctmm()`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/resample.ctmm.md) |
| Fit hidden Markov models (`momentuHMM`) | [`fitHMM.wrap()`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/fitHMM.wrap.md), [`draw.step.densities()`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/draw.step.densities.md) |
| Choose the clustering distance | [`get.epsilon()`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/get.epsilon.md) |
| Identify ARPs with DBSCAN | [`get.arp()`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/get.arp.md) |
| Link ARPs visited at different times | [`link.arp()`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/link.arp.md), [`draw.linked.clusters()`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/draw.linked.clusters.md) |
| Classify movement phases | [`class.mov()`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/class.mov.md) |
| Summarise and plot | [`phase.summary()`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/phase.summary.md), [`draw.track()`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/draw.track.md), [`draw.timeline()`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/draw.timeline.md) |
| Transfer phases back to the original locations | [`transfer.disperseR()`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/transfer.disperseR.md) |

## Example

The package includes simulated data for five dispersing individuals:
`sim_tracks` (raw locations) and `sim_states` (regular locations with
HMM states).

``` r

library(disperseR)

eps <- get.epsilon(sim_states)
arp <- get.arp(sim_states, epsilon = eps, delta.days = 2, pct.state1 = 0.2)
mov <- class.mov(link.arp(arp, thres = 24 * 3600))
mov
#> <disperseR object>
#>   Individuals: 5 | Locations: 3788
#>   Steps: ARP clusters (get.arp), Linked ARPs (link.arp), Movement phases (class.mov)
#>   ARP clusters per individual:
#> F02 F04 F05 M01 M03
#>   4   2   1   4   2
#>   Locations per phase:
#>     ARP Type 0 Type 1 Type 2 Type 2 or Type 1 Type 3
#> F02 629     55      0    142                0      0
#> F04 649     54    130      0                0      0
#> F05 159    161      0      0              129      0
#> M01 854     63     72    103                0     95
#> M03 364     55      0     74                0      0

draw.track(mov, colour.col = "phase", ids = "M01", colour.path = TRUE, km = TRUE)
```

![Track of individual M01 coloured by movement
phase](reference/figures/README-track.png)

``` r

draw.timeline(mov)
```

![Timeline of movement phases of the five simulated
individuals](reference/figures/README-timeline.png)

``` r

ph <- phase.summary(mov)
head(ph[, c("ID", "phase", "from", "to", "duration_days", "distance_km")])
```

The vignette describes the whole workflow and, above all, how the choice
of each argument changes the classification:

``` r

vignette("disperseR")
```

# Package index

## Prepare the tracks

Split tracks at monitoring gaps and regularise them.

- [`divide.track.by.gap()`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/divide.track.by.gap.md)
  : Split trajectory by time gap
- [`resample.ctmm()`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/resample.ctmm.md)
  : Resample tracking data using Continuous-Time Movement Models (CTMM)

## Behavioural states

Fit hidden Markov models and inspect the step lengths of each state.

- [`fitHMM.wrap()`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/fitHMM.wrap.md)
  : Fit Hidden Markov Models for Movement Data Classification
- [`draw.step.densities()`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/draw.step.densities.md)
  : Plot Step Length Densities by Behavioral State

## Area-restricted phases

Choose the clustering distance, identify ARPs and link them through
time.

- [`get.epsilon()`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/get.epsilon.md)
  : Calculate \\\epsilon\\ threshold for spatial clustering
- [`get.arp()`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/get.arp.md)
  : Identify Area-Restricted Phase (ARP) clusters
- [`link.arp()`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/link.arp.md)
  : Link Area-Restricted Phase (ARP) Clusters
- [`draw.linked.clusters()`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/draw.linked.clusters.md)
  : Plot linked Area-Restricted Phase (ARP) clusters

## Movement phases

Classify the movements between ARPs and transfer them to the original
locations.

- [`class.mov()`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/class.mov.md)
  : Classify movement phases
- [`transfer.disperseR()`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/transfer.disperseR.md)
  : Transfer classification data from disperseR object to a base dataset

## Summaries and plots

- [`phase.summary()`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/phase.summary.md)
  : Summarise movement phases
- [`draw.track()`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/draw.track.md)
  : Plot movement tracks
- [`draw.timeline()`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/draw.timeline.md)
  : Plot the timeline of movement phases
- [`print(`*`<disperseR>`*`)`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/print.disperseR.md)
  : Print a disperseR object

## Example data

- [`sim_tracks`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/sim_tracks.md)
  : Simulated dispersal tracks
- [`sim_states`](https://cherraiz.github.io/disperseR/reference/sim_states.md)
  : Simulated dispersal tracks with behavioural states
